svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: AKS application platform on Azure
svg.desc: AKS application platform on Azure. 8 components in 8 groups. Connections: Users to Application Gateway (HTTPS); Application Gateway to User nodes (HTTP to pod IPs (AGIC)); User nodes to Container Registry (pull images); User nodes to Managed identity (get token); User nodes to Key Vault (read secrets); System nodes to Log Analytics (diagnostics); User nodes to Log Analytics (diagnostics).

text.tspan: Application Gateway in front of AKS, with secrets read through workload identity and logs in Log Analytics
